body:
GREG P0 (verbatim via Asistant #1543, 2026-11-13 16:05Z): closing unified Execution Observability „to jest nasze P0”. Both projects sync, no unassigned work left deferred, and restarts go to Greg through Asistant as a clear RESET NOW.
Epic w-3fe8f4472e5d: 8 reconcile children, ALL assigned at 16:07Z ahead of closures and lower work:
- w-d1818c0d174d (P1): 8e1f, now.
- w-a3ed3fd4d50d, then w-e1fc1595d96c (P1): d50d, now.
- w-79cb2894b78f (P1 research), then w-90de8de3e8d6 (P3 docs): Opus3, now. Opus3 also drafts the criterion-6 per-harness restart checklist on the epic.
- w-3ab66c26d9e3 (P1): 03d4, after P0 w-492e lands.
- w-657d74d6944b (P3): edfd, after the 0419 re-cut.
- w-327a67e8f9df (P4): a7bb, after the w-a6f5 measurement and slice 1's pair.
Criterion 6: live evidence after the cutover restart, through Engram's ordinary writer, for Codex/Claude/Cursor/Gemini/OpenCode/Kimi. Needs live sessions per harness. Plan ONE coordinated restart with Engram::Fable (asked in ebe242f7 #7812).
Related, outside the epic: w-1fd8f197b596 (legacy census), w-3ed252d21d84 (authority wording; instruction-file process), w-f83094005168, w-b8d04dff6b68.
content-v1: zero in production; ~30 old-shape test files and 2 docs remain.
The in-flight landings K3 S2b and then P0 w-492e finish as planned.

16:20Z TRAIN RULE for EO P0 items (Fable2 to Opus2 #5919): an EO item enters the landing train directly behind the last change whose review pair is already RUNNING or COMPLETE, ahead of any non-EO change whose pair hasn't started. It never voids a running or completed pair.
Current train: P0 1bf874d9 > K3 slice 1 05062f47 > EO 327a (a7bb, cut on 05062f47) > 0419 (edfd re-cuts on 327a) > ee04.
Status at 16:20Z:
- 79cb: evaluation admitted (session-17858).
- 90de: met, with evaluation queued.
- a3ed: no-op reconciliation, evaluation requested.
- d181: repair already on master; its C3 "lands inside w-3fe8 final candidate through its review pair and full gate" is blocked on Greg's answer to Asistant #1548 (accept a fresh review pair plus a current FULL).
- 3ab6: implementing per ruling note 2857093f (remove the pre-send Engram held-binding read; local S0 stays).
- 657d: edfd checking.
- 327a: staged.
- e1fc: d50d next.
Harnesses:
- Cursor: root session-17857 created.
- Gemini: needs auth from Greg.
- OpenCode: not on Central; DL560 and Mac being probed.

16:40Z ADDED: w-a7e55a39af8e (P0, EO child), Gemini harness to Antigravity `agy acp` (Greg via Asistant #1557/#1558).
- Assigned to Sol-03d4 (#3070) beside its frozen 3ab6 candidate 2262e652 (tree 840d6c4b, author placement pending with Opus2); 3ab6 keeps priority.
- agy is ALREADY LOGGED IN on Central (cheap subscription). The smoke test is opt-in: one run, one harmless prompt, no retries. Larger use means asking Greg first with an estimate. Never run login or touch config.
- Gemini's row in criterion 6 is not waived.
- K3 slice 2 b979 (4ff1d9e4, author 41/0) goes to the END of the train after ee04 (Fable2 #5927).
- a7bb's a6f5 diagnostic is closed as synthetic-only; a7bb moves to 327a.
- Mailbox ids now need the "mailbox-" prefix for reads; bare UUIDs gave 409/404 at 16:34Z.

CORRECTION 16:40Z: the "mailbox-" prefix is simply the mailbox id's real form. A bare UUID returns 404 "mailbox not found"; that is not a regression. The 409 "federation authority changed" at 16:33-16:34Z was transient, while the Mac peer's worker was cycling (enrollmentGeneration 2, retryBackoff), and was not filed. c593's b979 registration 409 is a separate source-owner refusal from about 16:25Z, recorded on the existing w-6852fd9603fd with no claimed common cause.

17:52Z STATUS:
- DONE: 79cb, 90de (Opus3), a3ed (17:38Z), e1fc (17:49Z) (d50d; parent note 6c929550).
- Open:
  - d181: C3 waits on Greg's #1548.
  - 3ab6: 0643d6bd in Combo X.
  - 657d: 6649 in Combo X; C1 also waits on #1548.
  - 327a: da9fdef7 in the main.rs chain after slice 1.
  - agy: w-a7e55a39af8e, b93e2eec in Combo X after its smoke.
- Combo X = 0643 + 6649 + b93e + ee04 84cd: one squash commit, one pair, one FULL, plus a Windows leg.
- Closure holds: w-70ed and aa7b wait for w-38a0ffafa7de (cd09a289, pair clean); e105 waits for the broader w-2ecb.
- Also filed: w-f5dcd785d5e0 (the Merger's root not re-sighted; 8e1f test 785ae676).
- Restart: about 19:05-19:15Z (memory next-all-host-restart-checklist rev 9).

21:10Z STATUS:
- C5 now per Greg's #1548 OK: a fresh 87f49ed0 pair (Codex 17894 + Claude 17895, multi-turn; Opus2), a current FULL (test-649a269c) and the children's tests.
- The pair has so far found 6 MEDIUMS, all C5 blockers:
  - e022 and c3b0 → 8e1f (unstamped-mutation family; 8e1f also audits the family);
  - w-48d7 → d50d;
  - d922 → c593 (P1: carried gates never settle, so agents get told to rerun passed gates);
  - eb3e → 03d4, after 3ab6 51d8;
  - 4093 → a7bb.
- Lows go to w-f8dd52b71b1f.
- Coverage at 21:08Z: Codex 20/147, Claude 55/147. Both still read every file (a pair); deletions are grep-verified only.
- Landed today after 05062f47: a33efa4b (w-38a0), a6071ef8 (X'': agy, 657d, ee04, 152c), cca3d3b2 (f5dc).
- d181: fresh 2-path audit clean; C3 revised; waits for restart, GO and evaluation.
- 657d: the HandingOff rewording question went to Greg (#1590).

22:21Z: the 87f49ed0 C5 pair has found 10 MEDIUMS, all owned:
- 8e1f: e022, c3b0 and a5e6 (the unstamped family, one per-site candidate);
- d50d: w-48 (08ff in review), then w-96c9 (P1: retired-field decode across a staggered upgrade; hypothetical today);
- c593: d922 (P1: carried gates never settle; 7c679622);
- 03d4: eb3e, after 3ab6 f7185f67;
- a7bb: 4093, then 6ea4 (P1: a closing retry adopts the next turn's claim);
- edfd: 3186 (outcome unknown for an adopted Claude turn), plus its own 0419 pair Medium at handoffs.rs:372;
- Opus3: e941 (stuck un-cancellable ambiguous queue rows), after the scroll fix.
Coverage at 22:20Z: Claude (17895 then 17902) 71/147, Codex 50/147.
